_data_sources.scryfall: UNREACHABLE from this sandbox (403 on both api.scryfall.com and scryfall.com). Card mana costs/oracle text below are from the model's own MTG knowledge and are NOT live-verified against Scryfall this session.
_data_sources.edhrec: Reachable. Real deck-inclusion/synergy percentages fetched from edhrec.com/tags/card-draw/mono-red (519 decks) and edhrec.com/tags/control/mono-red (727 decks). No dedicated EDHREC tag exists for 'removal' or 'board-wipe' alone - 'control' is the closest real tag and mixes both.

draw.confidence: medium - real EDHREC popularity data available, but costs/effects are from own knowledge
draw.shape: loot (draw N, discard M<N), not clean unconditional draw

1.example: Faithless Looting {R}: draw 2, discard 2 - 62% inclusion despite net-zero card advantage; pure filtering alone justifies 1 mana in red

2.example: Thrill of Possibility / Tormenting Voice / Unexpected Windfall {1}{R}: discard 1, draw 2 -> net +1 card; this is red's real draw baseline at 2 mana, not draw-2-clean

3.note: shifts toward selection + opponent disruption rather than more raw cards (Demand Answers {2}{R})

5.note: NO reliable one-sided precedent found in mono-red EDHREC card-draw data at this cost. Do not score against an invented card-count target; judge on incidental upside (damage/treasure/wheel-symmetry) instead.

interaction.confidence: medium-high - real EDHREC control-tag data, Lightning Bolt is a very well-established reference point
interaction.shape: flat rate per mana for narrow/cheap removal, unconditional reach priced higher

1.example: Lightning Bolt {R}: 3 damage to any target, 43% inclusion - the reference anchor

2.example: Vandalblast {1}{R}: destroy 1 artifact, 46% inclusion - narrow (artifacts only)

3.example: Chaos Warp {2}{R}: hits ANY permanent, random replacement downside, 66% inclusion - the single most-played card in the whole control dataset; this is the 'unconditional removal' price point in red

boardwipe.confidence: low - no dedicated EDHREC tag exists; only one data point (Blasphemous Act) is confirmed via the control-tag fetch, the rest are from own knowledge only
boardwipe.shape: NOT a flat rate - needs a two-parameter model (base cost + scaling discount condition), a plain per-mana damage number misrepresents cards like Blasphemous Act

confirmed_example.base_cost: {8}{R}, reduced by {1} per other creature you control, minimum {R}
confirmed_example.edhrec_inclusion: 64% (464/727 decks) in the control tag - confirms this is close to a universal include in mono-red decks wanting a wipe
